svg.text: What happens during one set, from the camera to the coaching feedback
Every camera frame, on the user's device. No frame is sent to a server.
AFTER EACH SET, ON THE SERVER
Next.js server runs the analysis step against a self-hosted Supabase (Docker), reached over Tailscale Funnel
TypeScript port of the research engine
Thresholds, rules and messages are data:
one row per exercise in Postgres.
Show one warning, record every violation.
profile + medical history, last 5 workouts of this exercise, earlier sets of this workout
Live feedback to the user: a warning on screen and spoken, a beep for each correct rep
Next set or repair set, after the rest timer. The user tries again with the feedback in mind.
